meta.evidence_status: PROPOSED DESIGN (study B's recommended balanced nib B1; dimensions from bnib/optimise.py, masses CALC or ASSUMPTION; nothing built or measured)
meta.concept: two-axis translation nib on four wires, moving-coil axial-gap actuator, contact-driven counter-face balance at the refill's rear end
meta.replaces_note: the Rev J.1 C1S nose, gimbal, pen lift, nose Hall and the heel drive are removed; the skid ring shrinks to a 7 mm contact radius (the nib moves +-1 mm, not +-6 mm)

axis: z along the pen axis from the ball tip (z = 0) toward the back; x in the tilt plane, positive away from the paper; y sideways
moves_with_note: 'nib' = translates with the nib (carrier, coils, refill); 'handle' = fixed to the pen

components.label: Ball tip
components.function: The ink ball (0.7 mm, ISO 12757 class F).

components.label: Ink refill (D1 mini)
components.function: A standard replaceable refill; it slides along its axis in the carrier's bushings.

components.label: Refill end cap with rolling ball
components.function: Clips on the refill's end; a 3 mm hardened ball in it rolls on the counter-face.

components.label: Nib carrier (titanium tube with two bushings)
components.function: Carries the refill sideways (two PTFE-lined bushings at its ends) and the moving coils; the refill slides in it freely along the pen.

components.label: Moving coils (two flat layers, x and y)
components.function: Two racetrack pairs per layer over the four poles; current pushes the nib sideways. Moving coil: no magnetic pull or negative stiffness on the suspension.
components.part: self-bonding 0.10 mm wire on a 0.1 mm polyimide former (or a 4-layer flex coil)

components.label: Carrier flange (wire clamps, Hall magnet)
components.function: Clamps the four suspension wires (0.1 mm edge radius, Kt about 1.3-1.8) and holds the 1 mm position magnet.

components.label: Nib position magnet
components.function: Read by the 3-D Hall on the stator.

components.label: Magnet back plate (soft iron)
components.function: Carries the four poles and returns their flux.
components.part: AISI 1010 low-carbon steel, laser-cut (B_sat 1.6 T ASSUMPTION; Hiperco 50A would thin it: AMF-140)

components.label: Pole magnet (checkerboard)
components.function: Four poles in a 2 x 2 checkerboard around the refill; axially polarised, alternating.

components.label: Keeper plate (soft iron)
components.function: Closes the magnetic circuit behind the coils; the gap stays constant as the coils translate.
components.part: AISI 1010 low-carbon steel (ASSUMPTION; Hiperco 50A alternative: AMF-140)

components.label: Actuator housing and spacers
components.function: Holds plates and magnets at the set gap; bonded into the shell (heat path to the spreader).

components.label: Suspension wire
components.function: Four parallel wires (fixed-guided) let the carrier translate in x and y and hold it along the pen.
components.part: Ti-6Al-4V wire 0.128 mm, free length 26.8 mm

components.label: Wire anchor ring
components.function: Fixes the wires' rear ends to the handle; axial stops (20 um) protect the wires in a drop.

components.label: Nib position sensor (3-D Hall)
components.function: Measures the nib's x/y at 10 kHz; its reading is filtered by the servo's observer.

components.label: Counter-face (hardened disc on a 2-axis flexure)
components.function: The ink spring pushes this face against the refill's rolling end. Set parallel to the paper, it cancels the paper's push across the pen at every tilt; it rests on its follower stop when the ball lifts.
components.part: hardened steel disc 6 mm on a cross-strip flexure (301 FH)

components.label: Face spring (constant force) and follower stop
components.function: Constant-force spring along the face normal (the ink force); a slow stop set a gap beyond the writing position leaves the refill when the ball lifts.
components.part: stainless constant-force strip spring; lead-screw stop

components.label: Face positioners (2 x tilt/roll, 1 x stop)
components.function: Three slow screw motors with zero holding power set the face orientation from the IMU and the stop from the refill-slide sensor.
components.part: New Scale SQL-RV-1.8 x 3 (or micro-stepper lead screws)

components.label: Skid ring (C-shaped heel, 7 mm contact radius)
components.function: Rests on the paper and carries the hand's writing force; the ball sits about 5.4 mm in front of it at 50 deg.
